properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: keccak256 is the workhorse hash of the whole library: CryptoSwift .sha3(.keccak256) for ABI method signatures/event topics, EIP-55 address checksumming, keystore MAC, transaction and EIP-712 hashing, bloom filter; plus the bundled JS Keccak implementation (js-sha3-style Keccak class) used by the injected web3 bundle. Hash primitive — Grover only halves preimage strength; no migration required.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 is the keystore cipher on both sides: Swift keystores encrypt with aes-128-cbc by default or aes-128-ctr via CryptoSwift (EIP-2335-style cipher string in the V3 JSON), and the bundled eth-lib account code in browser.js defaults to createCipheriv('aes-128-ctr'). 128-bit key gives a 64-bit quantum margin under Grover; CNSA 2.0 prefers AES-256. Changeable here in the Swift defaults (keystore format interoperability constrains it).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Browserified randombytes/crypto.randomBytes is the CSPRNG entry point for the injected dApp-browser JS — the entropy source behind web3 account/key generation in the WebView ('0x' + crypto.randomBytes(size).toString('hex')). In a WKWebView it bottoms out in WebKit's crypto.getRandomValues, i.e. Apple's platform CSPRNG. Observable here; the implementation itself belongs to the platform, not this repo.
